dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Thanks to your help, the Varuna Contraption is now in good shape, and so is the Ashavan Realm.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: All Aranara have returned to Vanarana for the celebration of Festival Utsava, like birds returning to their nests.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: The angry rain becomes gentle again. And Aranakula finally gets to take care of the garden, growing Viparyas, happy Viparyas...

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Happy Viparyas make happy lanterns, and happy lanterns light the happy Festival Utsava...

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, the garden is doing great now, and Festival Utsava was a blast. Thank you for your help with healing the Varuna Contraption and bringing Aranakula back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All's well that ends well! Hee-hee...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speaking of which... I'm quite curious about something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why is Nara Varuna named Nara Varuna?

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Oh, it's because that Nara helped us heal the Varuna Contraption.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Um... No idea. Nara Varuna never told us {M#her}{F#his} real name.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} has also helped a lot. Nara {NICKNAME} is a brave Nara and has overcome many difficulties. That we can gather here together at Festival Utsava makes me very happy.

response.speaker: Arapandu
response.text: This is how Aranara say thank you.

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} will like it, and so will Paimon.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Here is an Aranara flower for brave Nara and Paimon.

response.speaker: Arakara
response.text: #Arakara also has a flower. It's not a Viparyas, but still, it's for Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

response.speaker: Arapandu
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, thanks for everything you did for Vana. We Aranara will never forget our friends!

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Don't worry. The baddies that made Vanarana sick won't be coming back!

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon for helping Ararycan protect Vanarana. Ararycan has flowers for you!

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Take the flowers, friends of Ararycan!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Festival Utsava... Feels familiar... Eh? It's White Floaty... and the Golden Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: It's the Nara friend, and the Nara friend's friend. Hope you will have fun during Festival Utsava.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: A friend's friend is also our friend! Golden Nara and White Floaty are both Aragaru's friends!
